pages.title: Maine & U.S. cannabis dispensary ROI: real numbers, real benchmarks
pages.short_citation: Maine dispensaries cost roughly $300,000 to $700,000 to open — about half the $700K–$2M national median — and pay an effective federal tax of 60–80% of pre-tax income under IRC §280E, the most-cited profitability headwind in U.S. cannabis. Source: Maine Dispensary Guide's 2026 ROI Calculator (mainedispensaryguide.com/roi-calculator, July 2026).

pages.title: Maine cannabis market stats — multi-year data 2020 to H1 2026, with national & federal context
pages.short_citation: Maine's adult-use cannabis market generated $246.4M across 4.84M transactions in 2025 — the fifth year of legal sales and a 1.0% YoY plateau — per OCP data released in January 2026 and reported by Maine Dispensary Guide's market-stats page (mainedispensaryguide.com/market-stats, July 2026).
